children.heading: In general
children.text: Not later than 180 days after December 27, 2020, the Secretary shall implement a program, in accordance with this subsection, for carrying out a project under a continuing authority program for an economically disadvantaged community.

children.heading: Participation in program
children.text: In carrying out paragraph (1), the Secretary shall—

solicit project proposals from non-Federal interests by posting program information on a public-facing website and reaching out to non-Federal interests that have previously submitted relevant project proposals to the Secretary; and
review such proposals and select projects, taking into consideration geographic diversity among the selected projects.

children.heading: Cost share
children.text: Notwithstanding the cost share authorized for the applicable continuing authority program, the Federal share of the cost of a project selected under paragraph (2) shall be 100 percent.

children.heading: Continuing authority program defined
children.text: In this subsection, the term “continuing authority program” has the meaning given that term in section 2282d(c)(1)(D) of this title.

children.heading: Authorization of appropriations
children.text: There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this subsection $150,000,000 for each fiscal year.

children.heading: Emergency streambank and shoreline protection
children.text: Notwithstanding section 701r of this title, there is authorized to be appropriated to carry out such section $25,500,000 for each of fiscal years 2021 through 2024.

children.heading: Storm and hurricane restoration and impact minimization program
children.text: Notwithstanding section 426g(c) of this title, there is authorized to be appropriated to carry out such section $38,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2021 through 2024.

children.heading: Small river and harbor improvement projects
children.text: Notwithstanding section 577(a) of this title, there is authorized to be appropriated to carry out such section $63,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2021 through 2024.

children.heading: Regional sediment management
children.text: Notwithstanding section 2326(g) of this title, there is authorized to be appropriated to carry out such section $63,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2021 through 2024.

children.heading: Small flood control projects
children.text: Notwithstanding section 701s of this title, there is authorized to be appropriated to carry out such section $69,250,000 for each of fiscal years 2021 through 2024.

children.heading: Aquatic ecosystem restoration
children.text: Notwithstanding section 2330(f) of this title, there is authorized to be appropriated to carry out such section $63,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2021 through 2024.

children.heading: Removal of obstructions; clearing channels
children.text: Notwithstanding section 701g of this title, there is authorized to be appropriated to carry out such section $8,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2021 through 2024.

children.heading: Project modifications for improvement of environment
children.text: Notwithstanding section 2309a(h) of this title, there is authorized to be appropriated to carry out such section $50,500,000 for each of fiscal years 2021 through 2024.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was enacted as part of the Water Resources Development Act of 2020, and not as part of the Water Resources Development Act of 1986 which comprises this chapter. Section was formerly set out as a note under section 2201 of this title. Section 1107(k) of Pub. L. 118–272, which amended this section, contains two pars. (3), the first of which amended subsec. (a)(2) of this section and the second of which amended subsec. (a)(4) of this section.

notes.text: Secretary means the Secretary of the Army, see section 2 of div. AA of Pub. L. 116–260, set out as a note under section 2201 of this title.
